svg.title: Labels that find a free place
svg.desc: Candlestick chart with 45 candles from Bar 0 to 44 and 2 series (Price, RSI). 2 stacked panes on one shared axis (Bar): Price, RSI. Price: open 100 at Bar 0, close 99 at Bar 44, a change of −1 (−1.2%); high 113 at Bar 13, low 95 at Bar 27. RSI – Highest: 95 (RSI at Bar 6). Lowest: 33 (RSI at Bar 43). Price – Reference lines: Invalidation at 100. Price – Zones: 1,50 ATR, Bar 19 to 25, values 100 to 104. RSI – Measures: Span at Bar 44: 30 to 39, difference 9.
svg.text: Labels that find a free place
